svg.aria-label: Progsu. Director · Georgia State Programming Club. Jan 2026 – Present. Built the Hacklanta hackathon platform (1,400+ applications, 700+ participants) and the club wiki serving 1,800+ members; secured partnerships with Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Adobe, MLH and more.
